description: Call ANY sipgate.io API v2 endpoint directly (covers the full API surface). Required: method (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE), path (with leading slash, e.g. '/history', '/contacts'). Optional: body (object), query (object → query string). Use the named sipgate_* tools for common resources; use this for anything else.

body.description: JSON request body sent to the API

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT or DELETE

path.description: sipgate.io API v2 path with leading slash, e.g. '/history'

name: sipgate_request
